reference_role: Environment composition and tonal separation only; no character generation.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone illustrated background image for an existing game's portrait dialogue stage. Generate ONLY the environment artwork, absolutely no characters, no portraits, no UI, no text. One single wide image, landscape 16:9, preferably 1536x864.
Input image: the provided reference is ONLY a visual guide for the environmental silhouette layering and background/foreground value separation. Do not reproduce the character, demonic pillars, black letterbox, dialogue box, or typography.
Style/medium: deliberately simplified 2D hand-painted cartoon game environment, broad angular silhouettes, confident big geometric masses, clean cel-shaded planes, subtle painterly brushwork, restrained edges. Compatible with crisp anime portraits with bold dark contours and bright blonde/purple/mint hair, peach skin, white shirts and dark jackets. Avoid photorealism and 3D-render appearance.
Composition/framing: eye-level interior, broad frontal wide stage. Preserve a calm backdrop across 18%-82% of image width and 10%-72% of image height, for one portrait at x=50% OR two portraits at x=25% and 75%. No busy objects, light strips, hard vertical edges or high-contrast outlines behind heads and shoulders. Main environment storytelling shapes frame the far left/right edges and upper corners; subdued large distant shapes elsewhere. Bottom 27% is simple shadowed floor, suitable to sit behind an external dialogue panel. Fill the entire image with environment; no black bars, no vignette panel or overlay.
Visibility: background must sit several value steps below the bright character artwork, mostly dark-to-medium-low values; muted saturation and small internal contrast. Keep portrait-zone paint around perceived lightness 18%-28%, broad low-contrast shapes with enough lifted shadow to separate even dark charcoal clothing/black outlines. No bright central halo, no saturated neon, no sharp light behind faces. Distant edge highlights never approach white. No strong purple, mint or yellow field matching portrait hair; no fluorescent red.
Constraints: no people, robots shaped like people, faces, silhouettes of people, foreground character or objects protruding into portrait area. No tiny bolts, wiring clutter, visual noise, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermark, stars, particles, glowing holograms. Deliver a complete clean background art asset, not a screenshot or mockup.
Scene/backdrop: a compact industrial maintenance hangar for a stylized sci-fi action game. Tall broad service-bay architecture, a shallow rear bay wall and distant recessed maintenance door at center, overhead thick crossbeam near top. At the far left a cropped broad structural column with a recessed shelf and very simple tool-storage shapes. At far right a chunky maintenance arm folded into the side wall and low silhouette of equipment cabinets, no humanoid mech. A quiet generous open middle; low shadowed floor fading into wall, sparse broad perspective seams only.
Color palette: desaturated smoky petroleum-blue and cool slate-charcoal, mid-dark blue-gray rear wall, darker navy framing beams, only two tiny subdued dusty amber utility lights at extreme upper edges. Highlights muted steel-blue, never pale cyan. Not a purple background. Quiet, spacious, professional pre-sortie atmosphere.
Primary request: Background 01 — BLUE SERVICE HANGAR, a polished minimal composition whose architecture is still readable while bright illustrated dialogue portraits remain visually dominant.

Color palette: very desaturated dark oxblood-brown and warm charcoal with dusty brick-gray planes, restrained matte muted rust-brown supports. Depth built from only four or five broad tonal layers.
